scope: Independent local engineering verification of frozen model, saved scientific records and pre-finalization release archives. Product UI work and subsequent regenerated archives require their own final checks.

environment.dependency_check: Exact direct dependency versions from requirements.txt; this review did not install into a new environment

checks: fixed epochs and no validation selection
five fixed seeds per selected config
raw observation inference equals NPZ inference

fresh_fit_archive_smoke.interpretation: One fit was removed and genuinely retrained inside an isolated archive extraction; the other 179 completed fits were reused.

inference_runtime.portable_runtime: current installed pinned Python environment; no fresh dependency installation in this audit

findings.title: No retraining needed for the current frozen release
findings.evidence: All frozen signatures matched; one scientific fit reproduced probability arrays exactly; deployed 10-member inference reproduced 486 saved predictions exactly.

findings.title: Compact paper archive contains generic full-project README and scripts
findings.impact: Legacy/raw inference and advanced deployment commands in the generic README require files available only in the full project/model archives. The eight paper tests and paper/SUPPLEMENT.md reproduction path are valid in the compact archive.
findings.recommendation: State archive scope in a package-specific entry document; do not present a generic README command as executable in every archive.

findings.title: Previous full-suite count excludes product UI tests being added during finalization
findings.impact: 45 denotes the exact core suite run in this audit, not a prediction about the later final test count.

findings.title: Engineering verification does not establish external field accuracy
findings.evidence: Advanced deployment uses the previously examined 486-point benchmark; paper_v4 is a retrospective spatial audit. No new independent field dataset was collected in this review.

retraining_decision.reason: Model artifacts, frozen protocol, source signatures and repeat inference are consistent. Repeating all 180 fits would not resolve the scientific generalization limitation.
triggers: A deliberate new protocol or feature design must use a new experiment version.
Future external labelled data should be evaluated with the current frozen model before any adaptation.

limits: Local macOS CPU runtime only; no new clean dependency installation or cross-platform claim.
Only one paper fit was freshly trained; all 180 saved records were independently recomputed and verified.
Release snapshot hashes identify pre-finalization archives; regenerated archives need a fresh manifest/hash check.
Product frontend/API security, usability and browser behavior were delegated to a separate implementation/test audit.
